rationale: Lisa's work building AI and XR solutions for industrial clients—including robotics integration and digital twins—directly aligns with Shryas's focus on embodied AI systems and robotics infrastructure at Kindred Ventures. As a founder scaling XR/AI/robotics consulting, Lisa could benefit from Shryas's research perspective on ML infrastructure and robotics foundations, while Shryas gains insight into how these technologies are being deployed at enterprise scale.
intro_message: Lisa Wang, meet Shryas Bhurat — you're both deep in the robotics and AI space from different angles (Lisa building enterprise XR + robotics solutions, Shryas investing in embodied AI infrastructure), and there's real potential to explore how foundation models and technical infrastructure enable the kinds of industrial automation systems you're shipping.
